title: Vector Control Reference
text: Compute d and q axis components of reference vector, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Theta units} sets Unit of input position value; {Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment} sets the dq reference frame and {Number of data points for trigonometric lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: θ e
ports.summary: Electrical position of reference vector scalar

ports.name: d ref
ports.summary: d -axis component of reference vector scalar

ports.name: q ref
ports.summary: q -axis component of reference vector scalar

params.name: Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment
params.values: dq reference frame alignment D-axis (default) | Q-axis

params.name: Theta units
params.values: Unit of input position value Per-unit (default) | Radians | Degrees

params.name: Number of data points for trigonometric lookup table
params.values: Size of lookup table array 1024 (default) | scalar
